newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish shares close mixed, outlook uncertain.
newsitem.headline: Finnish shares close mixed, outlook uncertain.

text.p: Finnish shares ended mixed on Wednesday with majors like telecoms group Nokia and oil group Neste posting gains while overall decliners outpaced advancers 2-1 and the outlook was uncertain, brokers said.

The FOX stock futures index ended 0.17 percent higher at 1,068.36, while the all-share HEX closed 0.06 percent up at 3,113.27. Turnover was lively at 700 million markka -- boosted by a big in-house transaction in forestry group Neste.
Nokia ended 3.00 markka higher at 362.00. Neste, fuelled by speculation of a possible merger with state-owned power group Imatran Voima, advanced 2.00 markka to 141.00.

Many domestic investors were already sidelined ahead of the long midsummer weekend, brokers said. The market lacked clear direction with some investors fearing the recent long rally had finally run its course.
Thursday would be very quiet and the post-midsummer trend was expected to be determined mainly by Wall Street and by how Nokia fared in New York, brokers said.

Among Wednesday's losers were forestry groups UPM-Kymmene, down 0.50 markka at 120.50, Enso, down 0.10 markka at 47.60 and Metsa-Serla, which fell 0.50 markka to 40.00 after announcing it planned a separate listing for its tissue paper unit.
